_doc: CWE id -> attack_vector, used by scripts/merge_and_dedupe.py step 4b to reclassify entries stuck at attack_vector 'other' when they carry CWE evidence. Precision-first: only CWE classes with one honest vector equivalent are listed - generic parents (CWE-20 improper input validation, CWE-74 injection), mechanism-only classes (CWE-184 incomplete blocklist, CWE-693 protection failure), memory-safety classes whose impact varies (CWE-125/787), and vectors absent from the controlled vocabulary (CWE-352 CSRF, CWE-611 XXE, CWE-295/347 crypto validation) are deliberately unmapped. An entry is reclassified only when EVERY mappable CWE it carries agrees on a single vector (unanimity rule) - mixed-signal advisories stay 'other' rather than guessing.
_source: CWE 4.x class semantics (cwe.mitre.org); auth-family and credential CWEs follow the repo's existing keyword-rule precedent (hardcoded credentials -> auth-bypass).
